Interim roles in public services

A council may need someone to take over a service while it recruits, or to run a change programme alongside the people keeping that service open.

What experience does the role need?

Running a service
Ask what the person has been accountable for. Managing a team and budget involves different decisions from advising the manager who holds them.
Changing how a service works
Look for experience of tracing what happens to a resident’s enquiry, testing a change with staff, and checking whether fewer people need to call back.
Leading a programme
Describe which decisions the programme lead can take and which belong to directors, elected members, or partner organisations.
